g.text: What --data-parallel-size 8 --enable-expert-parallel starts on one 8x B300 node
HTTP, chat rendering, DSML and reasoning parsing; routes each request
to the least-loaded engine core by queue length
expert-parallel all-to-all over NVLink, every MoE layer, every step (allgather_reducescatter by default)
host RAM (pinned), read by each GPU over UVA

Default placement: engram_config is None, so cpu_offload resolves to True; TP is 1, so each rank's shard is the whole table; embedding_across_dp is False, so DP ranks do not share. Eight copies, about 1.5 TiB.
With --engram-config '{"embedding_across_dp": true}' this becomes one table sharded eight ways; with '{"cpu_offload": false}' it moves into each GPU's 288 GB.
